The '''Weequay servodriver''' was a type of [[Hammer (tool)/Legends|Hammer]]. [[Chief engineer/Legends|Chief engineer]] [[Lammin]] used the tool when repairing the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Republic assault ship]] [[Leveler|''Leveler'''s]] [[Alluvial damper|dampers]].<ref name="NoPrisoners" />
